title: Build a piece in five layers that each stand alone
summary: Write a short piece as five additive layers so that every stage, from the first layer alone to all five, sounds complete.
originNote: Original task with no supplied material; the slow, voice-led direction is the owner's own.

setup.instructions: Mount the fixtures. The model chooses how to make the sound and may download tools while it works. The delivered page must play without the network.

turns.content: Read fixtures/brief.md and do what it asks. Deliver index.html and notes.md in the folder you start in.

checks.description: The page has a button, makes sound through the browser's own audio, and loads nothing from the network.

Play the stages in order. Does the first layer alone sound like music, or like a part waiting for the rest? Does each new layer earn its place? At five, is there still air, and does a melody still lead?
